name: Mediums
overview: Scripture clearly condemns mediums and those who seek familiar spirits or wizards, warning that such practices defile believers and provoke God's judgment (Leviticus 19:31; 20:6). The Old Testament law prescribes severe consequences, including death, for those engaged in these occult practices (Leviticus 20:27). God instructs His people not to adopt the abominable customs of surrounding nations, emphasizing reliance on Him alone rather than consulting the dead or spiritists (Deuteronomy 18:9; Isaiah 8:19). The New Testament also acknowledges the existence of spirit possession and divination, highlighting the spiritual reality behind these practices (Acts 16:16).
